$description: LAYER 2 (dark) — PageBanner. The light variant's background (light-400) is a dark gray in dark mode, so its text turns white.

a.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-text-accent-a (dark: the page color, dark text on a light or colored surface)

b.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-text-accent-b (dark: the page color, dark text on a light or colored surface)

dark.$description: Page banner dark text (dark): the "dark" banner is a light neutral on the dark page, so the text is the page color → --pgn-color-page-banner-text-dark

warning.$description: Page banner warning text (dark): the banner is a dark warning tint, so the text is the page text color → --pgn-color-page-banner-text-warning

a.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-bg-accent-a

b.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-bg-accent-b

dark.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-bg-dark

light.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-bg-light

warning.$description: Dark twin of the light token (scripts/sync-dark-tokens.js). Paragon default → --pgn-color-page-banner-bg-warning
